title: Mein Morgen — My Morning
summary: A short text about a morning routine.

paragraphs.text: Ich stehe jeden Morgen um sieben Uhr auf.
paragraphs.translation: I get up at seven every morning.
paragraphs.translation_en: I get up at seven every morning.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya bangun jam tujuh setiap pagi.

paragraphs.text: Ich dusche und frühstücke.
paragraphs.translation: I take a shower and eat breakfast.
paragraphs.translation_en: I take a shower and eat breakfast.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya mandi dan sarapan.

paragraphs.text: Dann fahre ich mit dem Bus zur Arbeit.
paragraphs.translation: Then I go to work by bus.
paragraphs.translation_en: Then I go to work by bus.
paragraphs.translation_id: Lalu saya pergi bekerja naik bus.

summary_en: A short text about a morning routine.

paragraphs.text: Meine Familie hat vier Personen.
paragraphs.translation: My family has four people.
paragraphs.translation_en: My family has four people.
paragraphs.translation_id: Keluarga saya ada empat orang.

paragraphs.text: Mein Vater ist Arzt, und meine Mutter ist Lehrerin.
paragraphs.translation: My father is a doctor, and my mother is a teacher.
paragraphs.translation_en: My father is a doctor, and my mother is a teacher.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ayah saya dokter, dan ibu saya guru.

paragraphs.text: Ich habe einen jüngeren Bruder. Er ist Student.
paragraphs.translation: I have one younger brother. He is a student.
paragraphs.translation_en: I have one younger brother. He is a student.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya punya satu adik laki-laki. Dia seorang pelajar.

title: Ein Tag in der Schule — A Day at School

paragraphs.text: Der Unterricht beginnt um acht Uhr.
paragraphs.translation: Classes start at eight.
paragraphs.translation_en: Classes start at eight.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kelas dimulai jam delapan.

paragraphs.text: Wir lernen Englisch, Mathe und Deutsch.
paragraphs.translation: We study English, math, and German.
paragraphs.translation_en: We study English, math, and German.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami belajar bahasa Inggris, matematika, dan bahasa Jerman.

paragraphs.text: Die Schule endet um drei Uhr.
paragraphs.translation: School ends at three.
paragraphs.translation_en: School ends at three.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sekolah selesai jam tiga.

paragraphs.text: Meine Stadt ist klein und ruhig.
paragraphs.translation: My town is small and quiet.
paragraphs.translation_en: My town is small and quiet.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kota saya kecil dan tenang.

paragraphs.text: Es gibt einen Park, eine Bank und zwei Restaurants.
paragraphs.translation: There is a park, a bank, and two restaurants.
paragraphs.translation_en: There is a park, a bank, and two restaurants.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ada taman, bank, dan dua restoran.

paragraphs.text: Die Menschen hier sind sehr freundlich.
paragraphs.translation: The people here are very friendly.
paragraphs.translation_en: The people here are very friendly.
paragraphs.translation_id: Orang-orang di sini sangat ramah.

paragraphs.text: Heute ist das Wetter sehr schön.
paragraphs.translation: The weather is very nice today.
paragraphs.translation_en: The weather is very nice today.
paragraphs.translation_id: Hari ini cuacanya sangat bagus.

paragraphs.text: Der Himmel ist blau, und die Sonne scheint.
paragraphs.translation: The sky is blue, and the sun is shining.
paragraphs.translation_en: The sky is blue, and the sun is shining.
paragraphs.translation_id: Langit biru dan matahari bersinar.

paragraphs.text: Es ist ein guter Tag für einen Spaziergang.
paragraphs.translation: It is a good day for a walk.
paragraphs.translation_en: It is a good day for a walk.
paragraphs.translation_id: Hari yang pas untuk jalan-jalan.

paragraphs.text: Mein Lieblingsessen ist Pizza.
paragraphs.translation: My favorite food is pizza.
paragraphs.translation_en: My favorite food is pizza.
paragraphs.translation_id: Makanan favorit saya adalah pizza.

paragraphs.text: Am Wochenende esse ich Pizza mit meinen Freunden.
paragraphs.translation: On weekends I eat pizza with my friends.
paragraphs.translation_en: On weekends I eat pizza with my friends.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di akhir pekan saya makan pizza bersama teman-teman.

paragraphs.text: Sie schmeckt gut, aber sie ist teuer.
paragraphs.translation: It tastes good, but it is expensive.
paragraphs.translation_en: It tastes good, but it is expensive.
paragraphs.translation_id: Rasanya enak, tapi harganya mahal.

paragraphs.text: Mein Hobby ist Fotografieren.
paragraphs.translation: My hobby is taking photos.
paragraphs.translation_en: My hobby is taking photos.
paragraphs.translation_id: Hobi saya adalah memotret.

paragraphs.text: Ich fotografiere gern Tiere und Natur.
paragraphs.translation: I like to photograph animals and nature.
paragraphs.translation_en: I like to photograph animals and nature.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya suka memotret hewan dan alam.

paragraphs.text: Am Sonntag gehe ich mit meiner Kamera in den Park.
paragraphs.translation: On Sunday I go to the park with my camera.
paragraphs.translation_en: On Sunday I go to the park with my camera.
paragraphs.translation_id: Hari Minggu saya pergi ke taman membawa kamera.

paragraphs.text: Ich war heute Morgen im Supermarkt.
paragraphs.translation: I went to the supermarket this morning.
paragraphs.translation_en: I went to the supermarket this morning.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya pergi ke supermarket pagi ini.

paragraphs.text: Ich habe Brot, Milch und Obst gekauft.
paragraphs.translation: I bought bread, milk, and fruit.
paragraphs.translation_en: I bought bread, milk, and fruit.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya membeli roti, susu, dan buah.

paragraphs.text: Alles war billig, also war ich glücklich.
paragraphs.translation: Everything was cheap, so I was happy.
paragraphs.translation_en: Everything was cheap, so I was happy.
paragraphs.translation_id: Semuanya murah, jadi saya senang.

paragraphs.text: Ich habe einen kleinen Hund namens Max.
paragraphs.translation: I have a small dog named Max.
paragraphs.translation_en: I have a small dog named Max.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya punya anjing kecil bernama Max.

paragraphs.text: Er ist schwarz und sehr freundlich.
paragraphs.translation: He is black and very friendly.
paragraphs.translation_en: He is black and very friendly.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia berwarna hitam dan sangat ramah.

paragraphs.text: Jeden Tag gehe ich mit ihm in den Park.
paragraphs.translation: Every day I take him to the park.
paragraphs.translation_en: Every day I take him to the park.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setiap hari saya mengajaknya ke taman.

title: Ein schönes Wochenende — A Nice Weekend

paragraphs.text: Letztes Wochenende habe ich meine Oma besucht.
paragraphs.translation: Last weekend I visited my grandmother.
paragraphs.translation_en: Last weekend I visited my grandmother.
paragraphs.translation_id: Akhir pekan lalu saya mengunjungi nenek saya.

paragraphs.text: Wir haben zusammen gekocht und viel gesprochen.
paragraphs.translation: We cooked together and talked a lot.
paragraphs.translation_en: We cooked together and talked a lot.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami memasak bersama dan banyak mengobrol.

paragraphs.text: Ich hatte eine sehr schöne Zeit.
paragraphs.translation: I had a very good time.
paragraphs.translation_en: I had a very good time.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya bersenang-senang sekali.
